title: Missed Installments, Failed Drafts and Plan Fees on a Patient Payment Plan
content:
**Credit and Collections policy — delinquency on a Patient Payment Plan**

**D1. Missed installment.** An installment of a Patient Payment Plan not paid (to the tier's part-payment share) within the tier's grace period, in calendar days, after its due date is missed, and the plan becomes past due.

**D2. Failed automatic payment.** A failed automatic payment is retried the tier's retry interval, in calendar days, later, up to the tier's number of retries, before the installment is treated as unpaid.

**D3. Late fee per missed installment (retired clause).** The clause "each missed installment adds the tier's late fee, up to the tier's limit of late fees counted over the plan's whole life" is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current basis of the Patient Payment Plan.

**D4. First late fee waiver.** The first late fee is waived on request where the tier waives the first late fee.

**D5. Returned ACH or check payment (retired clause).** The clause "a returned ACH or check payment adds the tier's returned-payment fee" is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current basis.

**D6. Declined card.** A declined card adds the returned-payment fee only where the tier applies that fee to declined cards.

**D7. Bringing a past-due plan current (retired clause).** The clause "a past-due plan becomes current when every missed installment is paid in full where the tier requires full payment of the past-due amount, or when the latest missed installment is paid where it does not" is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current basis. The tier setting that clause named — whether the full past-due amount is required — stays recorded on each tier (Yes on the Short-Term 3-Month, Standard 6-Month, Extended 10-Month, Long-Term 12-Month and Large-Balance 18-Month Payment Plans; No on the Hardship 24-Month Payment Plan); only the clause giving it that effect is retired.

## Illustrations of the clauses in force (hypothetical figures)

**D1, grace period.** An installment due 2026-04-01 on a tier with a 10-day grace period: the grace period runs to 2026-04-11. If the installment is still not paid to the tier's part-payment share by then, it is missed and the plan becomes past due.

**D2, retries.** An automatic payment for a 2026-05-15 installment fails on 2026-05-15. On a tier with a 3-day retry interval and one retry, it is retried on 2026-05-18; if that retry also fails, the installment is treated as unpaid.

**D6, declined card.** On a tier that does not apply the returned-payment fee to declined cards, a declined card adds no returned-payment fee.

superseded_clauses: Each missed installment adds late_fee, up to late_fees_max_per_plan late fees in the plan's life (payplan_msr_late_fees),
A returned ACH or check payment adds nsf_fee;
A past-due plan becomes current when every missed installment is paid in full where cure_requires_full_past_due is true, or when the latest missed installment is paid where it is false.
